_read: What the reviewer reads, in English. The fallback language: a key missing everywhere else
NOT here: logs (English, always, and not translated — a log is evidence, and evidence that
changes wording by locale cannot be grepped) and boot errors (a service that refuses to start
has no session and no chosen language yet).
`{name}` is replaced at render time. Keep the placeholder name, translate around it.
block.state.valid: validated, and nothing has changed since
block.state.stale: the text changed after validation — nobody approved the new text
block.state.broken: the text is unchanged, but what it depends on moved: {blame}
cycle.question: Question for the requester
limits.page.invalid: invalid page: expected a short code like {examples}, got "{got}"
limits.text.tooLong: the text is longer than {max} characters
limits.snapshot.tooLong: the block snapshot is longer than {max} characters
limits.block.tooLong: the block code is longer than {max} characters
limits.fingerprint.tooLong: the fingerprint is longer than {max} characters
limits.block.badChars: the block code has a character that is not a letter, a digit, a dot, a colon, a hyphen or an underscore
limits.data.keyTooLong: the data key "{key}" is longer than {max} characters
limits.data.notScalar: the value of "{key}" has to be text or a number
limits.data.valueTooLong: the value of "{key}" is longer than {max} characters
api.approval.needsBlockAndFingerprint: an approval needs a block and a fingerprint
api.request.notFound: request not found on this page
api.reason.required: give the reason or the question
api.commit.required: applied needs the commit (7 to 40 hexadecimal characters)
api.supplement.ownerOrAuthor: only the requester, or an admin, can add detail
api.supplement.tooLate: request {state}: to change something already approved, make a new request
api.credentials.invalid: e-mail or password do not match
limits.page.invalidNoExamples: invalid page: expected a short code, got "{got}"
